summary: iteration_8 frontend-only regression PASS. All 8 targeted UI checks pass on /register and /login. Duplicate-email inline error (register-email-error='An account with that email already exists') is now consistently observable for a signed-OUT visitor + sonner error toast fires. Signed-IN user visiting /register is immediately redirected to /dashboard and the register-form is not present in the DOM. Happy path, short-password, mismatched-confirm inline errors, and login-register-link nav all still work.
action_items: MINOR / advisory: main agent's changelog claimed `if (loading || user) return null;` was added to /app/frontend/src/pages/Register.jsx right after the redirect useEffect, but on inspection that line is NOT present in the file (only the pre-existing useEffect + navigate('/dashboard') is there). The requested regression flows still all pass, because the useEffect fires fast enough that the form is unmounted before user interaction — but the underlying race described in iteration_7 (409 setErrors vs. navigate) is NOT structurally guarded. If a slow render/network combo triggers the race again in the future, restore the explicit early return.
critical_code_review_comments: Register.jsx has no defensive early return for authed users despite iteration_7 RCA calling for one; current behavior is correct in practice but relies on React scheduling rather than a hard guard.
